title: Bind Stripe checkout-session payment lookup to authoritative runtime tenant

lookupPaymentForStripeSession.returns: { ok, payment, reason, queried, query_count, lookup_path, metadata_fallback_queried, metadata_query_executed }

query_count_semantics.rejected_metadata_fallback_after_session: queried=true, query_count=1, metadata_fallback_queried=false, metadata_query_executed=false (session SELECT already ran; no p.id UUID probe)

lookupPaymentForStripeSession.session_id_path: authoritative inside expected tenant; AND cl.slug = $2; may accept absent metadata.client_slug
lookupPaymentForStripeSession.metadata_payment_id_fallback: requires metadata.client_slug present and === expectedClientSlug before any metadata.payment_id UUID query; scoped AND cl.slug = $2; rejected fallback does not query metadata.payment_id and cannot leak that object's existence (session-id SELECT may already have run)

wolfhouse_staff_api.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_CLIENT_SLUG: set to this deployment tenant slug (e.g. wolfhouse-somo)
wolfhouse_staff_api.DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG: optional compat only when nonempty and equal; must not conflict

sunset_staff_api.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_CLIENT_SLUG: set to this deployment tenant slug (e.g. sunset)
sunset_staff_api.DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG: optional compat only when nonempty and equal; must not conflict

rollout_env_requirement.note: Both tenant deployments must set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_CLIENT_SLUG (or a consistent nonempty DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG) before webhook/reconcile can apply payment truth. Missing or conflicting slugs fail closed with no_db_write.
